name: Biometric Safety Measures
text: A security system is installed into the hilt of your lightweapon. When a creature other than you attempts to activate your lightweapon, the activation fails. Additionally, the creature attempting to activate it must make a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d10 lightning damage and is shocked until the end of its next turn. On a successful save the creature takes half damage and isn't shocked. On a success or failure, the creature then drops the weapon.
